questions.question: What should I do now for 3.15 support?

options.label: File backlog item only (Recommended)
options.description: Add a BK item under § 5 with the ripple list (classifiers, CI matrices, ALL_PYTHONS, docs chart, dependency-policy, drift-guard) and its 3.15 end date. Small and safe now, and it makes 3.15 trackable. Nothing is implemented.

options.label: Implement support now
options.description: Branch, add 3.15 to every spelling, run the suite on 3.15, fix breakage, and ship trace, CHANGELOG and backlog together. Bigger. Needs a 3.15 interpreter, and I cannot confirm that 3.15.0 final is out.

options.label: Item plus a 3.15 probe
options.description: File the item, and also try the suite on the newest 3.15 build available here. Gives the item measured breakage rather than a guess, without changing the supported set.

questions.question: How should 3.15 be gated, given I could not reach peps.python.org to confirm its final release date?

options.label: Only after 3.15.0 final (Recommended)
options.description: Classifier and the 'supported' claim wait for the final release. Matches the 3.14 precedent and the promise that nothing ships untested.

options.label: Add as pre-release in CI first
options.description: Add 3.15 to the CI matrix as allowed-to-fail now and add the classifier at final. Earlier signal, but it adds a non-gating lane and a rule for it.

answers.How should 3.15 be gated, given I could: Python peps are on GitHub too. peps/pep-0790.rst covers 3.15
